reviewed_by: Claude: project runtime stop pause and resume
reason: A deployment handoff evicts a project worker that does not finish within its grace; dead-owner reconciliation then interrupts its responses while Core keeps running. Those pauses claimed a Core restart. runtime_orphan_recovery now detects an unfinished release handoff of the exact dead source (ProjectHandoffRow source/fence, phase not verified, target_version differs) and records 'Project runtime stopped for a deployment handoff' or 'Project runtime stopped' as the cause, with recovery cause project_runtime_stop (chat.py _interrupt_orphaned_turn); chat_subagents adds that cause to the Core-resumed set so the promised automatic resume still applies. Unfinished harness turns of the dead owner are marked (recovery_markers.HARNESS_RUNTIME_STOP) so the new worker's harness startup (harnesses._settle_turn_after_restart) pauses the goal with 'Project runtime stopped [for a deployment handoff] during a harness goal turn; Core did not restart.' instead of 'Core restarted ...'; Butler goal hygiene classifies the new texts exactly as the old ones (transient). A failed automatic resume (chat._resume_stopped_turn) is now recorded as an operation failure and restates a paused goal's reason so it no longer promises an automatic resume. Python selects the new suite, the PostgreSQL dead-owner suite (test_runtime_orphan_recovery, which holds the new reconciliation tests), and the existing suites for the edited recovery, harness-goal, subagent and Butler hygiene paths.
exclusions: test_harnesses.py and test_chat.py are not selected: their changed-path tests pass, but test_harnesses.py::test_knowledge_access_change_refreshes_fixed_gateway_catalog, ::test_browser_attachment_refreshes_catalog_without_replacing_native_thread, test_chat.py::test_core_restart_recovery_bounds_concurrent_provider_turns and ::test_recovered_turns_waiting_for_recovery_capacity_hold_no_provider_slot fail on unmodified main (verified on a HEAD export); all other tests in both files pass with this change. test_harness_stopped_turns.py::test_turns_ended_by_the_vendor_leave_no_unretrieved_task failed once under a long serial run (StopAsyncIteration timing) and passes on repeat and in its suite; it does not touch the changed code. The deployer scripts are unchanged. No UI, native or Playwright change; no frontend checks. No full-suite approval.
